title: Open HMI Calculations (Tilt Tray overview) and verify system/bin/tipper statistics
summary: Use the Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU to open the HMI Calculations screen (Tilt Tray overview) from the ACB System screen, then confirm the screen shows populated information for system operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics for live operation.
when_to_use: When you need to verify that the Tilt Tray overview (HMI Calculations) is displaying live system operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics on the HMI.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate the Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU to the ACB System screen and open the HMI Calculations (Tilt Tray overview) screen; verify the displayed categories are present and populated.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU access to the ACB System screen and HMI Calculations screen

visual_references.description: Figure 4-6: HMI Calculations Screen (Tilt Tray overview) showing system operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics.
Figure 4-1: ACB System Overview Screen (used as the starting point for navigation to HMI CALCULATIONS).

steps.title: Open HMI Calculations from the ACB System screen
steps.purpose: Navigate to the Tilt Tray overview screen where system operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics are displayed.
steps.instruction: On the ACB System screen, press the "HMI CALCULATIONS" button.
steps.expected_result: The HMI Calculations (Tilt Tray overview) screen begins to load after pressing "HMI CALCULATIONS" from the ACB System screen.
steps.healthy_condition: The HMI Calculations screen loads successfully (i.e., you can see the HMI Calculations/Tilt Tray overview screen).
steps.failure_condition: The HMI Calculations screen does not open.

actions.label: Press HMI CALCULATIONS
actions.exact_action: Press HMI CALCULATIONS and the "ACB System" screen to access the "Tilt Tray" overview screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: HMI Calculations screen does not open

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Press HMI CALCULATIONS and the "ACB System" screen to access the "Tilt Tray" overview screen.

source_evidence.evidence: Context summary states navigation: press HMI CALCULATIONS button on the ACB System screen.

steps.title: Confirm the HMI Calculations screen corresponds to the Tilt Tray overview
steps.purpose: Ensure you are viewing the correct screen identity (HMI Calculations / Tilt Tray overview) before validating the statistics.
steps.instruction: Verify the screen you opened is the "HMI Calculations" screen and is the "Tilt Tray" overview.
steps.expected_result: The displayed screen is identified as the HMI Calculations screen and is the Tilt Tray overview.
steps.healthy_condition: You can confirm the screen identity as HMI Calculations (Tilt Tray overview) and proceed to review the statistics categories.
steps.failure_condition: The screen does not correspond to the Tilt Tray overview / HMI Calculations screen.

actions.label: Verify screen identity
actions.exact_action: Verify the "HMI Calculations" screen loads and corresponds to the "Tilt Tray" overview screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: Screen does not correspond to the Tilt Tray overview

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Press HMI CALCULATIONS and the "ACB System" screen to access the "Tilt Tray" overview screen. The "HMI Calculations" screen provides information pertaining to system operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics.

source_evidence.evidence: Context summary states the HMI Calculations screen is also referred to as the Tilt Tray overview screen.

steps.title: Review system operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics categories
steps.purpose: Locate the three required information categories on the HMI Calculations (Tilt Tray overview) screen.
steps.instruction: On the HMI Calculations screen, locate the displayed information categories for: (1) system operations data fields, (2) bin statistics values, and (3) tipper statistics values.
steps.expected_result: All three categories (system operations, bin statistics, tipper statistics) are visible on the HMI Calculations screen.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the system operations data fields, bin statistics values, and tipper statistics values as distinct sections/areas on the screen.
steps.failure_condition: One or more categories are missing or not visible on the HMI Calculations screen.

actions.label: Locate statistics categories
actions.exact_action: On the HMI Calculations screen, locate and review the displayed information categories: system operations data fields, bin statistics values, and tipper statistics values.

stop_or_escalate_if: System operations/bin statistics/tipper statistics categories are missing

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The "HMI Calculations" screen provides information pertaining to system operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics.

source_evidence.evidence: Context summary states HMI Calculations screen provides Tilt Tray overview with system operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics.

steps.title: Confirm the statistics fields are populated (not blank/missing)
steps.purpose: Validate that the HMI Calculations screen is showing live values for the required categories.
steps.instruction: Confirm the screen is populated with values (not blank/missing) for system operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics.
steps.expected_result: System operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics fields show populated values rather than blank/missing entries.
steps.healthy_condition: The system operations data fields, bin statistics values, and tipper statistics values are present and populated.
steps.failure_condition: System operations/bin statistics/tipper statistics fields are blank or missing.

actions.label: Check for populated values
actions.exact_action: Confirm the screen is populated with values (not blank/missing) for system operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics.

stop_or_escalate_if: System operations/bin statistics/tipper statistics fields are blank or missing

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The "HMI Calculations" screen provides information pertaining to system operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics.

source_evidence.evidence: Context summary states HMI Calculations screen provides Tilt Tray overview with information on system operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics.

success_criteria: HMI Calculations (Tilt Tray overview) screen opens from the ACB System screen.
System operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics categories are visible.
The system operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics fields show populated (non-blank) values.
healthy_conditions: HMI Calculations screen is displayed and corresponds to the Tilt Tray overview.
System operations data fields, bin statistics values, and tipper statistics values are present and populated.
failure_conditions: HMI Calculations screen does not open.
System operations/bin statistics/tipper statistics fields are blank or missing.
escalation_guidance: If the HMI Calculations screen does not open, or if system operations/bin statistics/tipper statistics fields are blank or missing, stop and escalate to support for further investigation.

missing_details: The source does not provide specific field names/labels or example value ranges for the system operations, bin statistics, and tipper statistics sections; the procedure therefore validates only that the categories are present and populated (not blank/missing).
